key_statements: Exact witnesswise product-indicator purification is valid on the noncompact line with zero loss; the v1 threshold-attainment proof was invalid, but v2 repairs it using common-supremum equality plus an equality-case exchange argument.
For A=M+F with every affine M-form density <=C_M, slab mass p, length ell, and a=(p-C_M ell)_+, every center m satisfies P{Q in J, |(X-m)^T F(X-m)|>a/(4C_M)}>=a/2.

In partner r11's M=D_C+lambda_1 vv^T, F=E_sep+lambda_2 ww^T chamber, rho>=2C_M forces positive on-slab mass either at radial scale rho^2 ell/(16 C_M C_D) or projective scale rho ell/(16 C_M |lambda_2|).

With an independent copy X', conditioned on both copies lying in the slab, at least 1/8 of slab-pair mass has the corresponding large difference-bank separation; simultaneously |(X-X')^T A(X+X')|<=ell. The ambient difference coordinates are independent and have density <=1.
scope_warnings: No interval, centered-uniform, bounded-diameter, or bounded-fragment extremality is claimed.
Conditioning on the double slab destroys independence; independence of difference coordinates is ambient before that event and is used only as provenance for future decoupling.
Full essential-bounded-density theorem remains OPEN; continuity remains separate.
